title.zh: 将莱特省圣菲市镇的皮纳哈德桑与17公里处小村改设为该市镇名为卡蒂普南与米拉格罗萨的村的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Sitios of Pinanhadsan and Km. 17, Municipality of Santa Fe, Province of Leyte, into Barrios of Said Municipality to be Known as the Barrios of Katipunan and Milagrosa, Respectively
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitios of Pinanhadsan and Km. 17, Municipality of Santa Fe, Province of Leyte, into Barrios of Said Municipality to be Known as the Barrios of Katipunan and Milagrosa, Respectively

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1697_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Pinanhadsan and Km. 17, Municipality of Santa Fe, Province of Leyte, are converted into barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrios of Katipunan and Milagrosa, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
